title: How Agents Ask for Permission: User Permissions for AI Agents, from Interfaces to Enforcement
abstract: arXiv:2607.13718v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As AI agents grow in prevalence, so too do their risks to users, creating a need for robust and usable systems for agent permissions. Many recent proposals implement product-level permissions, where the same security policy is applied for all users of a given agent framework. Yet different users have varying needs, necessitating support for user-level permission policies in agentic AI systems.   We survey 21 proposed user-level agent permissions systems and construct a taxonomy of approaches to specifying, deriving, and enforcing user-level permissions. We further analyze and compare against five commercial agents. We find that despite a wide diversity of proposals, sizable gaps remain in usability, transparency, and user control, particularly between academic and commercial agents.

translated_title: 智能体如何请求权限：面向AI智能体的用户权限，从界面到执行机制
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体日益普及，其对用户造成的风险也随之增加，因此亟需为智能体权限构建健壮且易用的系统。许多近期的方案实施的是产品级权限，即对给定智能体框架的所有用户应用相同的安全策略。然而，不同用户有着不同的需求，这就要求智能体AI系统支持用户级权限策略。我们调研了21个已提出的用户级智能体权限系统，并构建了一个涵盖用户级权限的指定、推导和执行方法的分类体系。我们进一步分析并与五个商业智能体进行了比较。我们发现，尽管提案种类繁多，但在可用性、透明度和用户控制方面仍存在显著差距，尤其是在学术智能体和商业智能体之间。
tldr: 该论文调研了21个用户级AI智能体权限系统并构建了涵盖权限指定、推导与执行方法的分类体系，通过对比商业智能体发现学术与商业方案在可用性、透明度和用户控制方面仍存在显著差距。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys 21 user-level agent permission systems, builds a taxonomy of approaches to specifying, deriving, and enforcing permissions, and reveals substantial gaps in usability, transparency, and user control—particularly between academic and commercial agents.
